paragraphs.text: Károly and Meg are at a small gathering with friends and family.
There are books, tables, chairs, windows and doors around the room.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A könyvek itt vannak. Az asztalok is itt vannak.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: A székek az ablakok mellett vannak.
Meg sees several friends and children. The families are together.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A barátok és a gyerekek együtt vannak.
Some things are big, some are small. Some objects are new and some are old.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: A nagy asztalok és a kicsi székek.

paragraphs.speaker: Károly
paragraphs.text: Az új könyvek és a régi könyvek.
There are a few empty chairs and several new books. Everyone is looking at the room.

paragraphs.speaker: Meg
paragraphs.text: Néhány szék üres. Több könyv van az asztalon.
